Analyse the examples:
In each example, there are two colored objects (rectangles/blocks).
- Example 1: 5 (gray, 3x3) and 7 (orange, 2x1).
  Orange moves horizontally towards 5 until it is adjacent to 5.
  Orange was at col 8, row 2..3. 5 was at col 2..4, row 2..4.
  Orange moved from col 8 to col 5 (adjacent to col 4).
- Example 2: 4 (yellow, 2x4) and 8 (teal, 2x2).
  Yellow is at row 1..2, col 5..8.
  Teal is at row 6..7, col 5..6.
  Teal moves up to row 3..4, adjacent to Yellow!
- Example 3: 3 (green, 2x2) and 6 (magenta, 3x3).
  Green is at row 3..4, col 1..2.
  Magenta is at row 4..6, col 6..8.
  Green moves right to col 4..5, adjacent to Magenta (which starts at col 6).

Notice which object moves:
- Ex 1: 5 (size 9), 7 (size 2). 7 moves towards 5. Smaller moves towards larger?
- Ex 2: 4 (size 8), 8 (size 4). 8 moves towards 4. Smaller moves towards larger!
- Ex 3: 3 (size 4), 6 (size 9). 3 moves towards 6. Smaller moves towards larger!

Does the smaller object move along the axis where they don't overlap, until they touch?
- Ex 1: overlap in rows (both have rows 2, 3). Separated in columns (cols 2-4 vs col 8).
  Orange moves left until touching gray.
- Ex 2: overlap in cols (teal cols 5-6, yellow cols 5-8). Separated in rows (rows 1-2 vs rows 6-7).
  Teal moves up until touching yellow.
- Ex 3: overlap in rows (both have row 4). Separated in columns (cols 1-2 vs cols 6-8).
  Green moves right until touching magenta.

So the smaller object moves straight towards the larger object along the axis of separation, until it touches it.
